Synopsis:
    A catastrophic flood in Nepal and China's Tibet region has left 570 tourists missing, including 476 foreigners from 29 countries. India leads with 177 missing nationals, followed by the US (63), Malaysia (55), Ukraine (53), Australia (34), Britain (33), and Canada (25). An additional 260 foreigners are missing in Tibet's Gyirong county. The event is a humanitarian disaster with wide international reach.
